errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос е обозначена като „Axis Title"
errors.evidence: The x-axis label is missing in the machine-generated description, but the image shows it is labeled with years.
The description refers to the yellow bars as 'бежов (пясъчен)', which is inaccurate as the bars are clearly yellow in the image.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates the number of electric cars sold and their percentage of total sales in Europe from 2019 to 2023.
The description does not mention the position of the legend, which is located at the bottom center of the figure.
